answer: Every identity grows a reef: 1,000 coral proofs, each costing about $0.01 of compute to grow. Each epoch a cipher tide rolls in — a new cipher sharded across raven couriers, random established peers, so nobody can pre-compute the encoding. Every reef must re-cipher all 1,000 coral within 48 hours or it bleaches and the identity loses established status. Forging 1,000 fake identities means growing 1 million coral: $10,000 of compute every 48 hours, forever, with zero revenue. Like a real coral reef, identity here is living tissue — stop feeding it work and it bleaches white and dies.
